headerButtonsMenu.Name: Header Buttons
headerButtonsMenu.Label: Configure Header Buttons
headerButtonsMenu.Hint: Configure which buttons appear in Actor and Item sheet headers

debugMode.Name: Debug Mode
debugMode.Hint: Enable debug logging to the browser console

enableTokenCounters.Name: Enable Token Counters
enableTokenCounters.Hint: Enable the Token Counters subsystem: configurable counters and macro buttons drawn around tokens. Adds a configuration button to actor sheet headers.

enableMovementRuler.Name: Enable Movement Ruler Colors
enableMovementRuler.Hint: Colour the token drag ruler by how far the token can still move. Speed ranges come from the active speed provider, which game systems and modules can supply through the module API.

movementRulerMenu.Name: Movement Ruler
movementRulerMenu.Label: Configure Movement Ruler
movementRulerMenu.Hint: Choose the speed provider and configure the ruler colours

musicCategories.Name: Music Categories
musicCategories.Hint: Custom categories for organizing music tracks

musicCategoriesMenu.Name: Music Categories
musicCategoriesMenu.Label: Configure Categories
musicCategoriesMenu.Hint: Add, edit, or remove music categories
musicCategoriesMenu.Title: Music Categories Configuration
musicCategoriesMenu.Notes: Define custom categories for organizing character music. Changes apply to all actors and items.

provider.Name: Active speed provider
provider.Hint: Providers supply the movement ranges used to colour the ruler. Game systems take precedence over modules.
provider.PlayerHint: Only a Gamemaster can change the active speed provider.

measurement.Name: Compare ranges against
measurement.Hint: "Movement cost" respects difficult terrain and movement actions; "Distance" uses the plain measured distance.

observerOnly.Name: Observers only
observerOnly.Hint: Only colour the ruler when the dragging user has at least Observer permission on the token's actor.

speedAttribute.Name: Speed attribute
speedAttribute.Hint: Property path resolved on the dragged token, e.g. actor.system.attributes.movement.walk. Leave empty to disable colouring.

dashMultiplier.Name: Dash multiplier
dashMultiplier.Hint: Multiplier applied to the speed attribute for the second colour band. Set to 1 or lower to use a single band.
